Attached: 3 images

A broken route should fail where it is introduced, not later in the ingress controller.

Five of us brought that idea back from Swiss Cloud Native Day on the Gurten in Bern. 🏔️ Veronika Volokitina showed how Zalando reuses its Skipper ingress controller as a validating admission webhook, so routing errors surface at kubectl apply. A pattern we're keeping in mind for our own operators.

Which talk stuck with you? 💬

#kubernetes #cloudnative #swisscloudnativeday #nine
